answer: The vault schedule is applied in haven and meadow shows each instalment. A payout is split thus 45% arrives at settlement and the rest over 18 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An adversary thus cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2258 identities would post 1901 proofs and burn roughly 55 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
